title: Stardew Valley

quotes.text: If you're reading this, you must be in dire need of a change.
If you're looking for seeds, my shop is the place to go. I'll also buy produce from you for a good price!
I was born an ordinary boy, but I made a decision early in life that I would become extraordinary.
Eric Barone spent four and a half years building the game alone, coding nights after shifts as a movie-theater usher.
Barone built Stardew alone — except multiplayer, which Chucklefish's Tom Coxon wrote in 2018.
Barone did the art, the code, and every note of the soundtrack himself, despite having no formal music training.
Every farm ends up with one shed nobody remembers the purpose of and forty chests nobody wants to sort.
You tell yourself this will be the year you get to bed before 2am in-game. It will not.

notes: appid 413150 confirmed via Steam appdetails (type=game, developer/publisher both 'ConcernedApe'). Grandpa's letter quote is the verbatim opening sentence of the longer in-game letter (full text confirmed on stardewvalleywiki.com, trimmed to the first sentence to stay under the length cap while remaining an exact substring). Pierre and Mr. Qi quotes are verbatim from their stardewvalleywiki.com character pages (fetched via curl with a browser User-Agent since plain WebFetch 403s on that wiki, same snag noted for UESP). Dev trivia (4.5-year solo development, usher job, Tom Coxon writing the 1.3 multiplayer netcode, self-taught soundtrack) cross-verified across Wikipedia, TheGamer, and Steam's own 1.3 patch notes.
